Title: Azure API Management Consumption tier is now available in 13 new regions

Body.Content:
Azure API Management Consumption tier became generally available in May 2019. Unlike other Azure API Management tiers, the Consumption tier exposes serverless properties. It runs on a shared infrastructure, can scale down to zero in times of no traffic, and is billed per execution.

 

The Consumption tier is now available in 13 more regions (19 in total). The full list of supported regions includes:

  • Australia Central (new)
  • Australia Central 2 (new)
  • Australia East
  • Australia Southeast (new)
  • Brazil South (new)
  • Canada Central (new)
  • Central US (new)
  • East Asia (new)
  • East US (new)
  • Korea Central (new)
  • North Central US
  • North Europe
  • Southeast Asia
  • South India (new)
  • UK West (new)
  • West Europe
  • West India (new)
  • West US
  • West US 2 (new)

Explore valuable API Management resources, including publications on using it in serverless and microservices-based architectures, which the Consumption tier is especially well-suited for.
